title: fix(metadata-protocol): a first draft of a sealed package-shipped item names the edit remedy; a refused first-write pin's 409 states its assertion
body:
Fixes #23406
Clause-②: no

A first draft of a sealed, package-shipped item is now refused with that item's own remedy. A refused first-write pin's 409 now states what the caller asserted. Which requests are accepted or refused does not change, and no code or status changes either.

## What changed

- **The sealed refusal's remedy.** `saveMetaItem` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`) now reads a present `null` parent as the spec does: "no current row of this lifecycle" (`SaveMetaItemRequestSchema.parentVersion`).
  - On a draft save, that lifecycle is the draft's. So `If-None-Match: *` with `?mode=draft` over a held name is a first draft of the item already there, which is an edit. Its refusal (`403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE`) now names the edit remedy, byte-equal to the sentence the unpinned draft reads.
  - A first write of the live row (`If-None-Match: *` with no `?mode=draft`) keeps the create remedy.
  - `sealedWrite` is now `create` only for a `null` parent on a publish save. Both of its readers get the new value: the flow authoring rule (`tenantAuthoredWriteRefusal`) and the package door (`refusePackagedBaseOverride`).
- **The first-write conflict sentence.** The save door's `409 METADATA_CONFLICT` for a refused first-write pin now reads: "TYPE/NAME: this save asserted that no draft row exists (the first-write pin, If-None-Match: * on the REST door), but one does (current is VERSION). Send that version as If-Match to save over it, or re-read the item to merge first." A save without `?mode=draft` reads "no active row" instead.
  - It used to read "TYPE/NAME has been modified since you loaded it. Expected parent null but current is VERSION."
  - The new sentence is used only when the request sent `parentVersion: null` and the repository judged a `null` parent. An unpinned save that loses a race keeps the old sentence, as does every other conflict.
  - The code, the status, `currentVersion`, `actualHead` and `expectedParent` are unchanged. No error code is added: the ADR-0112 ledger is untouched.

## Measured at the REST door

The harness is the real `PUT /api/v1/meta/:type/:name` route over a real `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` and `SchemaRegistry`. The `object` is registered under a package id, so it is sealed (`object` takes no environment overlay). Each request was run on both kernel shapes. The before column was read on base `086fa4640f`, with `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`'s `dist/` built from that base (the new REST pin was red there). The after column was read on this branch's head.

| Request | Before (`086fa4640f`) | After (`6f79997618`) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `?mode=draft`, unpinned | 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`, edit remedy | unchanged |
| `?mode=draft` + `If-None-Match: *` (a first draft) | 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`, create remedy ("… so its name is taken. To author your own object, choose a name …") | 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`, edit remedy, byte-equal to the unpinned draft's |
| `If-None-Match: *`, no `?mode=draft` (control: a create) | 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`, create remedy | unchanged |
| `?mode=draft` + `If-None-Match: *` over an existing draft (real better-sqlite3 stack) | 409 "… has been modified since you loaded it. Expected parent null …" | 409, the assertion sentence |

## The dispatch's mechanism assumption A2, measured false as stated

A2 asked for the create-or-edit judgement to read only whether a row exists under the name, a package-shipped base included, and not to read the pin.

- **That fact is constant where it would be read.** Both readers of `sealedWrite` are reached only for a name that a managed package or the loader's set holds: `isSealedManagedItem` implies `isArtifactBacked`. A judgement that read only that fact would make every `/meta` sealed refusal an edit.
- **That would leave the create remedy with no producer.** The only other producer of `operation: 'create'` was Setup's position write-through, and it has been deleted (`.changeset/pre/15204-7b-position-write-through-retired.md`). The create remedy would be reachable from no door, and the triage scope's "true create as control" could not be pinned.
- **What this PR reads instead** is the lifecycle the pin speaks of. A draft pin speaks only of the draft, and over a held name the item exists, so the save is an edit. A publish pin asserts that the item has no live row, so the save is a create.

The suggested route ("derive the remedy from the existence of a row under the name") holds on the draft side, where that existence is already in hand at the refusal and no lookup is added. The existing `[#22591]` publish-mode pin in `protocol.sealed-remedy-kind.test.ts` is unchanged and green.

## Tests

- New: `packages/rest/src/rest-meta-sealed-first-draft-remedy.test.ts` covers the three REST requests on both kernel shapes. It asserts the remedy KIND each request reads, from what the sentence points at: the listing route for a create, the source and redeploy remedy for an edit. It also asserts `403`/`NOT_OVERRIDABLE` on all three, and that the first draft's sentence equals the unpinned draft's.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.sealed-remedy-kind.test.ts`: a new block covers `object`, `position` and `flow` on both kernel shapes. In each, a first draft names the edit remedy and equals the unpinned draft's sentence and `packagedBaseRefusal({ operation: 'save' })`. A publish-mode first write still names the create remedy. The `[#22591]` block's title and doc now say "publish save"; its assertions are unchanged.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.served-content-hash.test.ts`: the unit pin for the conflict sentence. A first draft over a pending draft, and a first write of the live row over an existing one, each read the assertion sentence. It names the lifecycle, the pin and the current version, never "since you loaded it" or "Expected parent". Code, status and keyed fields are unchanged, and the sentence carries no stored hash. A stale-token conflict keeps the door's own sentence (the control). The pin sits beside the save door's other conflict pins, on the in-memory double that file already has.
- `packages/rest/src/meta-item-version-token-occ.test.ts`: the existing "`If-None-Match: *` … refused 409" case also asserts the new sentence at the REST door.

These runs were made at head `6f79997618`, all under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` and chained with `&&`, which gave one verdict: `command-exit 0`.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: `Test Files 236 passed | 3 skipped (239)`, `Tests 28418 passed | 19 skipped (28437)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol typecheck`: passes. `tsc --listFiles` counts both touched metadata-protocol test files in the program.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over the 5 touched or neighbouring door files: `rest-meta-sealed-first-draft-remedy`, `meta-item-version-token-occ`, `rest-meta-managed-seal-hatch`, `rest-meta-packaged-flow-refusal` and `meta-draft-head-package-inheritance`. Result: `Test Files 5 passed (5)`, `Tests 40 passed (40)`. These tests read `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` through its `dist/`, which was rebuilt from this head first.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest typecheck`: passes, including `check:test-typecheck` ("0 file(s) / 0 error(s)" held in the debt ledger).

Only the touched rest files were run, not the rest suite: no exported symbol or published shape moves (`Clause-②: no`).

## Ablations (each pin goes red with the fix ablated)

Each fix was committed first. Each mutation went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, whose anchor must hit; it checks the counts and blob hashes on disk and restores the file under a trap. The REST legs rebuilt `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, then ran `scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` before reading a result.

- **Remedy, at `cb609acdd8`.** The judgement was put back to `request.parentVersion === null ? 'create' : 'save'`.
  - Anchor 1 → 0, blob `7c1363e21d2b` → `88b7d5a6032a`. The dist preflight found the marker in 2 built files.
  - Unit: 6 failed, 13 passed. Every new first-draft row flipped to `new-name`. The `[#22591]` and enumeration blocks stayed green.
  - REST: the new pin failed on both kernels (`firstDraft: 'new-name'`). The OCC file stayed green.
  - Restore: blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, whole-tree porcelain clean, then a rebuild. `--absent` confirmed the marker gone from all 24 built files, and all tests went green again.
- **Sentence, at `cb609acdd8`.** The first-write branch was made unreachable (`firstWritePin` compared with a literal that no caller sends).
  - The dist preflight found the marker in 2 built files.
  - Unit: both assertion cases failed. REST: the OCC first-draft case failed.
  - The restore and `--absent` legs were as above.
- **Sentence, at `6f79997618`, after the unit pin moved into `protocol.served-content-hash.test.ts`.** Same mutation. That file read 2 failed and 27 passed (its control stayed green), and the restore proved blob equal to HEAD with porcelain clean. This unit leg reads `./protocol.js` from `src/`, so it needed no rebuild.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 65 commands at `6f79997618`. All 65 were run at that head and each exit code was recorded. `--ran` reconciled them: "65 derived, 65 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN (a DERIVED zero — all 65 recorded an exit code)". Every exit code was 0.

- `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first answered `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` (exit 3), because this fresh worktree had no `dist/` for 47 packages. After a full `turbo run build`, it answered "110 published require entry point(s) across 68 package(s) load".
- `check:engine-double-contract` named a first draft that placed the conflict pin in a new file with its own pinned double, because that would have grown the retained ledger. The pin moved onto the existing double instead, and the gate is green with the ledger untouched.

**Lint** was narrowed to the 5 touched TypeScript files: `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config --format json` read 5 files, 0 errors and 0 warnings.

- Each file is inside the config: `--print-config` resolves 5 rules for each.
- The config enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`, no `projectService`), so this diff cannot move the verdict on any untouched file.
- The repository-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- **A boundary this card leaves as it was: a first write of the live row over an item served from a package artifact.** `GetMetaItemResponseSchema.version` says such an item serves `version: null`, "so the next save creates one: pin it with `If-None-Match: *`". A client that edits a sealed item through the live row, pinning from its read, therefore still reads the create remedy. That is the `[#22591]` reading and this card's control. The door cannot tell that edit from a client creating its own item under the name, because both carry the same pin. No one is assigned to carry this.
- **The draft door has the mirror case.** It cannot tell a client creating its own item in draft mode from a first draft of the held item. Under the spec's draft-lifecycle reading that save is an edit. A client creating its own item says so with a publish-mode first write.
- **A stale docblock.** `packagedBaseRefusal`'s "`create`" section still names "Setup's position write-through" as the caller that asks `create`, but that module is retired. It is outside this card's change and is left for the next PR that touches that docblock.
- Seat 1's S2 (#23469) edits `protocol.ts` in another region. No merge with `main` was needed: this branch is cut from `086fa4640f`, and the push had no conflict.
